sector.narrative: Support for feminist, women-led and women's rights organisations and movements, and institutions (governmental and non-govermental) at all levels to enhance their effectiveness, influence and substainability (activities and core-funding). These organisations exist to bring about transformative change for gender equality and/or the rights of women and girls in developing countries. Their activities include agenda-setting, advocacy, policy dialogue, capacity development, awareness raising and prevention, service provision, conflict-prevention and peacebuilding, research, organising, and alliance and network building

Stakeholder policy roundtables in Homabay county and Mombasa County. Engagement with County Directors to discuss the Homabay SGBV Policy where the county eplored the posibility of setting up safe houses in the county to respond to SGBV. In Mombasa County, we had a stakeholder engagement with county officers and private sector where we evaluated the proposed SGBV bill and expanded the definition of vulnerable groups to include sex minority and intersex persons who had been left out of the initial policy that was developed.

Conducted a one-day sensitization workshop on Mombasa County SGBV policy draft for the County Assembly Members and Health Committee. Launch of the 16 Days of Activism Advocacy Campaigns International Women’s Day and 16 Days of Activism. As part of commemorating 16 Days of Activism, CWID held 1 FEMME Tribe conversation. 75 participants attended (71 female, 4 Male, 3 Intersex and 10 Women with Disability) On the 8th of march 2022 International women’s day we had conversation with 17 young women in Sakwa Siaya County where we engaged them on SGBV and Reproductive health and body autonomy.Social media advocacy where we showcased the work of two young women under WGG who are doing great work in the community. 3 outreach forums to the strengthening of the We for She movement from Mombasa; 2 webinars by we for she amplifying their work on teenage pregnancy; and two webinars Feminist Evolve from Nyanza who are engaging vibrantly in online spaces and one at ground level on elimination of SGBV during 16days of activism.
